## HN discussion (0 comments)

(no comments)
{"decision": "pass", "reason": "页面是一个标准的心情记录器，功能与数百个同类工具相同，没有明显的新角度、特定垂直场景或创意呈现；唯一的特点是数据只存浏览器本地，但这本身并不构成值得打扰读者的产品创意。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason says the only distinguishing trait is browser-local storage, which the page confirms ("Saved in this browser on this site... No cloud backup or sync"). It also calls the page a standard mood tracker with no new angle, which matches the basic date/mood/note/calendar features shown. Naming the local-storage mechanism and dismissing it as insufficient gives a concrete, post-specific argument that supports the pass decision.
